business_problem: GM needed to get developers productive on new assignments faster while keeping its engineering environment agile, policy-compliant, and secure across multiple projects.
solution_summary: GM moved developer setup and project environments onto Microsoft's cloud developer stack so engineers can start work immediately without waiting on manual workstation setup. Microsoft Dev Box provides preconfigured cloud workstations with the tools, databases, and security settings each project needs, while Azure Deployment Environments spins up standardized services and test environments from self-service templates. GM combines those services with GitHub Copilot and GitHub Advanced Security so developers can write code faster, publish applications remotely, and keep changes inside a zero-trust model with real-time vulnerability analysis. The result is a code-to-cloud workflow that reduces onboarding friction while preserving project-level isolation, compliance, and rapid delivery.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Dev Box
solution_components.role: Provides preconfigured cloud development workstations so engineers can start new projects quickly.

solution_components.name: Azure Deployment Environments
solution_components.role: Automates creation of standardized application environments and services from self-service templates.

solution_components.name: GitHub Copilot
solution_components.role: Suggests code and helps developers contribute faster inside their existing engineering workflow.

solution_components.name: GitHub Advanced Security
solution_components.role: Scans code for vulnerabilities at check-in so teams keep developer speed without dropping security controls.

business_outcome: Together, GitHub Copilot and GitHub Advanced Security enhance productivity in a secure environment and get new developers to their first pulls faster.
metrics: About 400 GM developers have been using GitHub Copilot since February of 2023, and the response has been very positive.
“Often GitHub Copilot gets them 98% of the way there, and they only need to make small changes to finish it up.”
architecture_clues: The solution to GM’s need for agile setup and administration of developer environments was to move these operations to the Azure cloud.

Microsoft Dev Box centrally manages cloud-based development workstations that are preconfigured and ready-to-code with all the tools and security settings already provisioned for the developers’ needs.
Azure Deployment Environments helps GM quickly spin up the services an app needs to run using standardized, self-service templates built for projects.
GitHub Advanced Security analyzes code in real-time and alerts developers to vulnerabilities at the moment they check in changes, while GitHub Copilot speeds contribution on new work.

data_flow: Developers start from a preconfigured Dev Box image, provision app services through Azure Deployment Environments, and publish code through GitHub-backed workflows where security checks run at check-in time.
